column1: # The red run: this tree's assertions against the engine the base ref holds,
# written whole by tests/red, which tests/run --record-assertions calls.
#   run   <failed>  <passed>  <skipped>        lines counted, not the summary
#   <assertion name>  <times it failed>        failed names only
# A base of - means no red run was possible. Reproduce with: tests/red <ref>
a 200K Write holding 2,000 escaped quotes is refused on its path through the hook inside twenty seconds
a 44K command with 8,000 escaped quotes is refused through the hook inside twenty seconds
a large payload whose awk fails part way has no subject, rather than the part it printed
a large payload's subject is read by exactly one awk
read by awk and by expansion alike: a payload holding a raw SOH byte, which JSON cannot, has no subject
reading a large payload's subject is linear: four times the payload costs under eight times the CPU
